assertions.description: The :navigation-source pseudo-class parses through the Selectors API (querySelector does not throw).
The pseudo-class combines with type selectors and descendant combinators, as in the spec's a:navigation-source .thumb example.
When no navigation is ongoing the current navigation state is null, so no element matches :navigation-source.
A plain div can never be a navigation source element, so div:navigation-source matches nothing even mid-navigation; at minimum the compound must parse and match nothing on an idle page.
The element that triggered the current navigation (link, form, or submit button) matches :navigation-source for the course of the navigation, and stops matching when it settles.
assertions.test: Requires a real user-initiated navigation and mid-flight sampling; the selector-parse-lab concept's sampler and the loading-links/form demos measure this with element.matches(':navigation-source') during an intercepted navigation.
